headline: Mooring and Stonecradle Blaze as Cape Cools Slightly
war_summary: Since the morning edition the centre of movement has shifted while Mooring County holds its pace. Mooring still counts six changes in two hours and twenty-five on the day around The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, showing ten Warden, one Colonial and one ruined post amid 2,424 Colonial and 2,208 Warden casualties in two hours. Stonecradle has flared to match it with six changes in two hours and nine on the day at The Dais and World's End, all nine posts still listed Colonial amid 255 Colonial and 345 Warden casualties in two hours. Callum's Cape has cooled to two changes in two hours, though thirty-eight on the day around Scouts Jest, Naofa and Ire, holding four Warden, two Colonial and one ruin with heavy loss. Marban Hollow reports four changes in two hours at Checkpoint Bua, the Weathered Expanse three at Spirit Watch and Necropolis, and Linn Mercy two at Outwich Ranch, while the Nevish Line, Godcrofts and Callahan's Passage record none in the last two and six hours.
